build_queryinst_model: build a QueryInst instance segmentation model with ResNet50 backbone and FPN neck for COCO dataset
configure_sparse_roi_head: configure a SparseRoIHead with 6 stages, DIIHead bbox heads, and DynamicMaskHead for instance segmentation
setup_hungarian_assigner: setup HungarianAssigner with FocalLossCost, BBoxL1Cost, and IoUCost match costs for training
configure_adamw_optimizer: configure AdamW optimizer with backbone learning rate multiplier of 0.1 and gradient clipping at 0.1
setup_linear_multi_step_lr_scheduler: setup LinearLR warmup followed by MultiStepLR scheduler with milestones at epochs 8 and 11
